explanation: Removes leading/trailing and repeated spaces and standardizes name capitalization for the sample; review name exceptions and retain raw data.
solution_outline: Correct inconsistent capitalization, spaces and number formats.
Expected: standardized display fields, preserved original IDs, documented transformations, and a checked before/after sample.
The solution must be verified using the included sample data; the text check alone is not evidence that the workbook itself meets the rubric.
validation_cases: Normal case: calculate at least one record by hand and reconcile with workbook output.
Edge case: test a blank, duplicated record, threshold boundary, unknown key, or failed refresh appropriate to the task.
Review data types, number formats, accessibility and compatibility as relevant.
